The researcher registered an account whose display name was ``, placed an order, and opened `GET /orders//receipt`; the payload ran. They also showed that a product name containing a double quote (we import names from supplier feeds) breaks out of the tooltip attribute on the line items, e.g. `Pen" onmouseover="steal()`. While you're in there: a product called `Fish & Chips Plate` produces invalid HTML because the ampersand is emitted raw. Everything dynamic on that page (names, ids, amounts) must be rendered as text, never as markup, both in element content and in attribute values.

setup.create: """Tiny HTML helpers for server-rendered pages (receipts, packing slips).""" def escape(value) -> str: """Make ``value`` safe to embed in HTML text and in double-quoted attributes.""" text = "" if value is None else str(value) return text.replace("<", "<").replace(">", ">") def tag(name: str, text, **attrs) -> str: """``tag("td", 3, class_="qty")`` -> ``3``. The text and every attribute value are escaped. A trailing underscore in an attribute name is dropped (``class_`` -> ``class``). """ rendered = "".join(f' {key.rstrip("_")}="{escape(value)}"' for key, value in attrs.items()) return f"<{name}{rendered}>{escape(text)}"

"""Printable HTML receipts, linked from the order confirmation email.""" from shop.utils.dates import isoformat from shop.utils.html import escape, tag from shop.utils.money import format_money def _line_row(line, products, currency: str) -> str: product = products.get(line.sku) name = product.name if product is not None else line.sku return ( "" + tag("td", name, class_="item", title=name) + tag("td", line.quantity, class_="qty") + tag("td", format_money(line.line_total_cents, currency), class_="num") + "" ) def render_receipt(order, user, products) -> str: """Full HTML document for ``order``; ``user`` may be None for guest orders.""" cur = order.currency customer = user.name if user is not None else "customer" rows = [_line_row(line, products, cur) for line in order.lines] totals = [ ("Subtotal", order.subtotal_cents), ("Discount", -order.discount_cents), ("Shipping", order.shipping_cents), ("Tax", order.tax_cents), ("Total", order.total_cents), ] total_rows = [ "" + tag("th", label) + tag("td", format_money(cents, cur), class_="num") + "" for label, cents in totals ] parts = [ "", '', f"Receipt {escape(order.id)}", f"

Thanks for your order, {customer}!

", f'

Order {escape(order.id)} placed {escape(isoformat(order.created_at))}

', '', *rows, "
", '', *total_rows, "
", "", ] return "\n".join(parts)
